name: Blink
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

While the spell lasts, roll a feat die at the end of each of your turns:

  • On a 1-5, nothing happens.

  • On a 6-10, you phase out, and phase back in to a space within short range at the start of your next turn.

  • On 🌞, you no longer need to roll each turn and may phase in or out once each turn as a free action while the spell lasts.

  • On 💀, you phase out and do not phase back in until the spell ends. Check a condition.

Describe how you disappear and reappear.
